QuestInfo.name: Catch that Thief!
QuestInfo.0: So what exactly happened to make you return to the island? You'd better go talk to #b#p1201002##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1201002# was devastated to have his #t4032312# stolen! The thief responsible for this mess, #o9001013#, apparently headed toward #m140020300#. Maybe he's planning to escape on a boat. You need to go to #m140020300# and battle #r#o9001013##k.\r\n\r\n#o9001013##r #a213011##k
QuestInfo.2: You returned after eliminating #r#o9001013##k, but you couldn't retrieve #b#t4032312##k... After hearing this, #b#p1201002##k got VERY angry.

0.0: There's a robber on this island! I don't know who it is, but the thief removed a #b#t4032312##k from my body! I'm sure the thief disguised himself as a penguin, so no one would notice him, and then he just walked right out with it!
0.1: I kept screaming, but no one paid any attention, so that really got me frustrated. Worse, that girl #p1201000# kept trying to tie me up because I was making too much noise. Seriously, I can't deal with human beings.
0.2: Wait, we don't have much time. You must catch the thief before he leaves the island! He took the #t4032312# and headed towards the #bharbor#k. He was walking, as casually as could be, so I'm sure he is still on this island. Catch that thief for me!
0.3: Who's the thief, you ask? Well, what kind of bird is obsessed with jewels? The crow! That means it's #r#o9001013##k!\r\n\r\n#b(You will move to #m140020200# when you accept. You can move to #m140020300# from there.)

no.0: What? What?! You don't want to? I thought you said I have to look my best for you to use your skills, and now you're telling me this? No way! You must do this for me!

mob.0: You still haven't captured #r#o9001013##k yet? He's probably headed toward the #bharbor#k, so maybe you'll find him there? Hurry up!
